preToolUse.bash: p=""; for r in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "."; do if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/hook.mjs" ]; then p="$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/hook.mjs"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$p" ]; then node "$p" preToolUse; else mkdir -p "$HOME/.apex-plugin-spike/logs"; { date -u; pwd; env | grep -iE 'plugin|copilot|claude'; } >> "$HOME/.apex-plugin-spike/logs/unresolved-preToolUse.log"; cat > /dev/null; fi; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: $p = $null; foreach ($r in @($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, '.')) { if ($r -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $r 'com.github.copilot/hooks/hook.mjs'))) { $p = Join-Path $r 'com.github.copilot/hooks/hook.mjs'; break } }; $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($p) { $in | node $p preToolUse } else { $d = Join-Path $HOME '.apex-plugin-spike/logs'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; ((Get-Date -Format o) + ' ' + (Get-Location) + ' ' + ((Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object Name -match 'PLUGIN|COPILOT|CLAUDE' | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + '=' + $_.Value }) -join ';')) | Add-Content (Join-Path $d 'unresolved-preToolUse.log') }; exit 0
